messages:
Alex: async check-in — what I did: rotated canary for kv-evict and ran a quick warmup replay, saw a brief 5xx spike. blockers: waiting on S3 creds to run full replay. today: open PR to add batcher debounce + guard and follow up on postmortem.
Sam: pushed draft PR #4130 for debounce + runtime guard, needs review. few inline comments on value choices.
Maria: saw an alert spike in eu-west ~03:12, looked noisy. probably autoscaler lagging with the new canary.
Jordan: I pulled logs from gpu-02, error looked like an OOM when allocating tensor — maybe quantized kernel mismatch with this model variant.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-084 — alert: embed-service:5xx-rate. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-5xx
Alex: thanks @Jordan. can you paste the log snippet? I can roll back the canary if needed.
Jordan: log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:12:09Z gpu-02 tensor alloc failed: cudamalloc: out of memory
model=redwood-opti-v1 seq=1024 batch=64
```
Sam: suggestion: temporarily reduce `max_batch_tokens` to 32 and add a runtime guard to reject requests > 512 tokens. reduces blast radius quickly.
Maria: re: SLOs — current debounce for this alert group is 10s, which is noisy. propose increasing to 30s for now.
Alex: agree on debounce bump. I'll open an ops PR to bump debounce and add a metric for prefix cache hit rate.
Sam: PR #4130 created: `runtime: guard large token requests + debounce config` — requesting one approval.
Jordan: LGTM, will approve after CI passes. I'll also try a minimal repro with quantization flags locally.
Alex: update: infra granted S3 creds to me, I'll run the full replay after PR merges.
Maria: oncall note: if embed-service error rate > 1% over 5 min, page oncall. adding to runbook.
Sam: tagged @oncall-team in INC-2026-084 and linked the PR.
Alex: quick ask — can someone watch CI for #4130 and post green? then I'll roll the debounce change to canary-2.
Jordan: I'll watch CI, ping me if it times out.
ops-bot: deploy started: canary=2, image=registry.redwood/embed:v1.2.4-cb
Sam: CI passed, green ✅
Jordan: CI green, approving now.
Alex: rolling canary down + applying debounce bump. will update runbook with OOM detail.
Maria: added the OOM note to the runbook link above.
Sam: quick followup: who owns postmortem? Alex volunteer?
Alex: I can own the postmortem and draft timeline tomorrow, will include latency/cost impact and remediation steps.
Jordan: I'll attach log dumps and repro notes to the postmortem.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-084 resolved at 2026-03-18T04:15:00Z — summary: transient OOM caused by batcher configuration + long sequence lengths, mitigated by debounce + runtime guard.
Alex: done for today: PRs pinged, canary adjusted, postmortem owned. blockers: none.
Maria: done: runbook update, monitoring tweak applied. blocking: none.
Sam: done: PR reviews & CI, will help with postmortem.
Jordan: done: log captures + repro attempt ongoing, will upload artifacts.
Alex: any other quick asks? if not, thanks team :thumbsup:
